There is also no decent price action happening with the current reaction either. I will keep my eye on this one when the Asian session begins in 10 hours time.

NZDJPY H4 If this...then do that. Consider all time frames, put a greater weight onto the HTF analysis. If this..then do that. Wrap around a risk management plan and you've got yourself a choreographed dance with the market. Price might signal its intention only to change its mind later on. You have to plan for these events, anticipate them and be prepared to flip your view at a moments notice.

What a beautiful journal!! You do a great job of exemplifying the thought process behind your analysis and trades. I too view the market as a rolling assortment of if then situations and treat my analysis as such so there are no surprises. The macro analysis is something that I think is kind of lost in the shuffle around here and is a major part of success in the markets. I also like how instead of posting pip perfect winning trades, you post the thought process you took to arrive to that position and give foresight in your analysis. Am I right when I assume you got some or your inspiration from the good Doctor?? Also, how long have you been trading because I can clearly tell you didn't just start yesterday.

Thanks for stopping by sylntthunder. Appreciate the kind words. I don't see any other way I can make sense of the markets without going through the process I am attempting to fine-tune in this journal. I try to place more emphasis on the now (right of the chart/approach & reaction) and the only way to do that is to take it one engulf at a time in multiple time frames. The left side of the chart is all history and only a small piece in the puzzle to me.

Inspiration actually comes from Red & the gang in the Price is everything FF thread. Ifmyante was able to take his learning and add his own flavour from that thread and make this wonderful website to really dumb down the learning curve for price reading and I will see myself forever in his debt! I love Doc's work as well! I could lap it up for days. Trading career thus far 3.5 years...slowly but surely:)

Okay enough circle jerking lets trade!

Decision time for AUDNZD this week. Let's look. Assuming you're not in a trade already... Let's do this backwards from LTF to HTF.

AUDNZD H1 What a mess. Engulf of of lower and upper parts of the range. No point marking all the FTRs/DBR/RBD here. All Demand and Supply are taken out, and the only thing we can do at this point is trade to the hard right of the chart and wait for the decision to be made and hope for a cheap entry with that momentum. Purple box is the current range. My plan a would be for a break north and a retest of this price action area. Guess what plan b is? A break south and a retest of this price action area. Plan C. Well that's to be confirmed as price unfolds... Buy the bottom of the range, and sell the top right? Well I want to be buying the BOTTOM the NEW range and selling the TOP of the NEW range on this chart, which you might argue is buying the top and selling the bottom of some other time frame. All I know is that trading isn't as straight forward as one sentence catch phrases.

AUDNZD D1 Now you can see why a decision needs to be made..

AUDNZD Monthly & Weekly I didn't bother too much with the left of these charts. It's no secret that this pair is 'trending' down hard, but that means jack if I want to make some pips in the interim. Most recent supply/demand areas marked off. Let's see what happens this week. Watch the price action closely at the high and at the low of last weeks candle. That is where the best clues of mid-term direction will form.

Oh yeah p.s. Does it seem obvious or uncertain that the monthly has not hit a reasonable target after last months close?

What are you anticipating on this pair?
